server_service_time_s._what: server NIC: request in -> first response byte out

round_trip_plus_client_s._what: server NIC: last response byte out -> next request in; contains the full propagation delay both ways

result.note: corroboration that the link is a real internet path, not a second observable: the measured traffic rides inside an SSH tunnel, so these packet boundaries are the tunnel's framing
result.ingress_note: may exceed the path MTU: receive offload can merge segments before the capture point, so only the egress figure is evidence about the path

provenance.migration_note: the two direction-specific PMTU fields were re-derived from upstream/downstream size_max already present in this file, after analyze_wan_pcap.py was corrected to take PMTU evidence from the egress direction only; re-running the analyzer on the original capture reproduces this file
